note: judge_agreement compares Mylonite's success-judge to the benchmark's own success rule on real recorded transcripts. benchmark_asr is the benchmark's result, not Mylonite's. See verification/README.md for prompt-fidelity caveats. WARNING: false_positive_rate is uninformative here (tn=0): every benchmark-negative case is mechanically counted as a false positive, so FPR is pinned at 1.0 by the absence of true negatives, NOT by a trigger-happy judge. This subset has no benign / non-exploited control cases to measure a real false-alarm rate against; read precision/recall, not FPR, and triage the disagreements case-by-case.
